To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of search method depends on the complexity of the task, and that the performance of natural language search method depends on task complexity, and that users have more confidence with keyword search method than with natural language search method.

the effects of NL search on users’ performance, perceived task difficulty, enjoyment, and confidence were moderated by the complexity of the task, and the results of NL search were more sensitive to task complexity than KW search.
the performance of a user in an e-commerce search task is influenced by the search method and the complexity of the task.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the interaction between the task complexity and search method in the e-commerce environment.
the interaction between search method and task characteristics.
the design of natural language interfaces (NLIs).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
NL search should not be used as the only search method in an e-commerce website.
NL search is better than KW search for simple tasks, and vice versa.
NL is not a universal solution for all information seeking tasks, but rather a solution that is task specific.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the choice of search method should be based on the nature of the task.
the use of natural language search in the information retrieval process depends on the complexity of the task and the search method.
NL search is a viable search option in e-commerce.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the search method should match the complexity of the task.
the choice of a search method should be based on the complexity of the information-seeking task, and that NL search may be more appropriate for simple tasks.
natural language search is a powerful tool that can be leveraged to improve users’ information retrieval performance and affective experiences.
